stories.title: Macy's Thanksgiving Day parade postponed due to weather for 1st time in 100-year history
stories.summary: New York City officials, the NYPD and Macy's have decided to postpone the annual Thanksgiving Day parade, sources familiar with the decision told ABC News.

stories.title: Rain, wind gusts will affect Thanksgiving travel
stories.summary: Rain will gradually build over Central NC from south to north, with greater coverage in the afternoon and evening.

stories.title: Durham Rescue Mission Thanksgiving feast to go on despite rain, expected to serve more than 2,000
stories.summary: The Durham Rescue Mission is preparing to serve more than 2,000 people during its annual Thanksgiving Feast.

stories.title: Thanksgiving travelers navigate delays at RDU during busy holiday rush
stories.summary: Thanksgiving travelers at RDU navigated delays and cancellations as the holiday travel rush got underway.

stories.title: Andy Taylor, guitarist of new wave icons Duran Duran, dies at 65
stories.summary: Andy Taylor, the original guitarist of Duran Duran, has died at 65. The band was known for hits like "Hungry Like the Wolf" and "Rio."

stories.title: Andrew Scott explores love, loss and legacy in new film 'Elsinore'
stories.summary: Andrew Scott takes on a deeply personal story about art, mortality and the devastating impact of the AIDS crisis in the new film "Elsinore."

stories.title: Cumberland County advocates share resources for domestic violence survivors during the holidays
stories.summary: Advocates say the holidays can add financial pressure, travel, and planning stress, which may make abuse worse.

stories.title: Trump admin proposes new tariffs on China, EU and 12 other trading partners
stories.summary: A senior admin official said the countries were informed of proposed tariffs.

stories.title: Massachusetts high court denies attempt to delay Lindsay Clancy retrial
stories.summary: An appeals court court has denied an attempt to delay the retrial of Lindsay Clancy, the mother charged with killing her three children before she tried to kill herself.

stories.title: Suspect, second person arrested in connection with deadly shooting, crash in Johnston County
stories.summary: The sheriff's office said 20-year-old Kaseem Nijil Jones of Whitakers was arrested for the Friday morning shooting on Ravensworth Drive in Garner.

stories.title: Kilmar Abrego Garcia leaves the US, self-deporting to Spain
stories.summary: Kilmar Abrego Garcia, who was returned to the U.S. after being mistakenly deported to a Salvadoran mega-prison, has self-deported to Spain.

stories.title: North Carolina sees rise in flu activity ahead of Thanksgiving travel
stories.summary: The number of positive flu tests in NC has steadily increased during the past month, hitting 1,080 during the most recent week of reporting.
